interpretation: Descriptive measurement-qualification evidence, not final research findings. All five repetitions are retained. The same 200 queries are reused; repeated executions, conditions, and the two graph builds are not pooled as independent samples. No inferential test, cache-causality claim, or proof of steady state is made. Historical and pilot campaigns are context, not a matched comparison.

prevalence.threshold_interpretation: Historical thresholds are exploratory descriptions, not retroactive acceptance tests.

query_features.interpretation: Descriptive only; supplied full-1M unfiltered distances are query features, not filtered 100k ground truth.
